description: Retry policy for TeamHarness MCP actions. Data only. mcp/server.py @ d8332e0a has NO automatic retry loop: failures that are safe to retry return retryable:true and the caller (the agent) re-invokes; safety comes from idempotency, not from backoff.

current.evidence: retryable:true markers plus caller-driven re-invocation; idempotency anchors: pre-minted delegation transaction id (delegate-{task_id}-{nonce} persisted on the task before send), deterministic signal event ids (id_rule v1.2), submission fences, the 'assigned + eventId' idempotent return, and committed-cancellation retry fencing
retryable_error_markers: cannot pull authoritative project state from shared storage; retry
state persisted locally but shared-storage sync failed; retry to complete
state persisted locally but follow-up state update failed
task is assigned but shared-storage sync failed
task assigned but shared-storage sync failed; retry to complete
failed to publish task files to shared storage
shared storage sync failed after complete_project

recommended.jitter_note: uniform random delay in [0, interval] added to each computed backoff delay

note: initial_interval / backoff_factor / max_interval / max_attempts / jitter are W1 proposals (no code source); retry_on lists the retryable error strings that actually exist in mcp/server.py
